prompt_instructions: Treat named Chinese actors, TIFF, and award claims as unverified placeholders; use fictional cast and fictional laurels unless rights and facts are supplied.
Keep the film and all credits fictional by default.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a fictional fantasy-adventure comedy poster titled '寻龙秘境' (The Dragon Realm Quest). Set it in an underground cave full of strange glowing plants and ancient ruins. At center, a comic explorer with a moustache, safari hat and multi-pocket vest stares wide-eyed at a glowing compass; beside him, a leather-clad female adventurer with a crossbow holds her forehead with a wry smile. Surround them with coins, ancient scrolls, a giant dinosaur-egg fossil, and a huge sleeping stone dragon statue with faint red eyes. Render a gold dimensional Chinese title with dragon-scale texture and the subtitle '不仅要命，还要钱！'. Use colorful fantasy adventure lighting, magic and bioluminescence, jewel blue, emerald and gold, creating a humorous, thrilling, mysterious atmosphere. The source reference also specifies Huang Bo, Shu Qi, Happy Mahua, Yan Fei, Peng Damo, TIFF People's Choice Award 2024, Baihua Award, Industrial Light & Magic and Jackie Chan Stunt Team; treat all of these names, logos and claims as unverified placeholders requiring approval.
prompt.negative_prompt: real actor likeness without consent, false award claims, false studio credits, generic dragon, flat cave, unreadable title, watermark, signature
